name: Litto and Tobi: Dusk's Secret
source:
Litto and Tobi are the controversial spouse. This time, they would like to show people the secret of yellowish dusk. However, on the way revealing the truth, they were surrounded by special forces. What was happening? Find out on short story of Litto and Tobi: Dusk's Secret.

[From [url=http://www.renai.us/game/dusk-secret.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
translation:
利托和托比是备受争议的配偶。这一次，他们要向人们展示黄色黄昏的秘密。然而，在揭露真相的途中，他们被特种部队包围。发生了什么事？了解《利托和托比：黄昏的秘密》的短篇故事。

[来自[url=http://www.renai.us/game/dusk-secret.shtml]仁爱档案馆[/url]]
